name: VRM_REVENUE_DOC_LINES_GT
description: VRM_REVENUE_DOC_LINES_GT contains information about revenue lines during the revenue document processing.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of revenue document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number of a revenue document line.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Code name of the document line type.

columns.name: UNIT_REVENUE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price of a line to be recognized by a revenue recognition process.

columns.name: EXTENDED_UNIT_PRICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Extended selling amount is calculated from unit selling price times quantity.

columns.name: EXTENDED_REVENUE_PRICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Extended revenue amount is calculated from unit revenue price times quantity.

columns.name: EXTENDED_CARVED_OUT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Carve out amount of a MEA line.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier or a revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of a revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration for the revenue schedules when using a Variable Schedule rule type.  Number of periods to recognize revenue.

columns.name: RULE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date for revenue recognition when utilizing the Daily Revenue Rate, All Periods or Daily Revenue Rate, Partial Periods revenue rule types.

columns.name: RULE_END_DATE
columns.description: End Date for revenue recognition when utilizing the Daily Revenue Rate, All Periods or Daily Revenue Rate, Partial Periods revenue rule types.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a revenue document.

columns.name: QUANTITY_CREDITED
columns.description: Quantity that has been credited.

columns.name: QUANTITY_INVOICED
columns.description: Quantity that has been invoiced.

columns.name: PREV_REVENUE_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a line of a previous revenue document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of revenue that has been scheduled.

columns.name: UNSCHEDULED_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount of unscheduled revenue.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount of a source document line.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of contingencies applied to the line.

columns.name: REQUIRES_MANUAL_SCHEDULING

columns.name: MEA_NUMBER

columns.name: LINK_TO_REV_DOC_LINE_ID

columns.name: RULE_DURATION_PROCESSED
